attributes.cardDescription: Record an authentication verdict for a collection item, and sync the outcome onto the item itself.
attributes.readMe:
## Authenticate Item

The spec's `AuthenticateItem` tool. Creates a full `AuthenticationRecord` (service, authenticator, certificate, notes) and — when the verdict is `passed` — syncs `verifiedOn`/`verifiedBy`/`verificationReference` onto the linked `CollectionItem`, so a prerendered fitted tile can show a verified badge without resolving a link.

### No matrix concept existed

Confirmed absent from all 590 tracker rows — a pure new command.

### Example

`linkedExamples` points at the command's natural target: `CollectionItem/aj1-lost-and-found-105`.

### A failed verdict does not auto-refund

`authentication-record.gts`'s own header says failure "in an escrow flow this refunds the buyer" — that is a fact about what should happen next, not something this command does unasked. Refund is money moving, and `RefundOrderCommand` is its own explicit call.
